title: Major disaster declaration DR-4898-TN: Winter Storm
summary: FEMA records a major disaster declaration (DR-4898-TN, "SEVERE WINTER STORM") for TN, dated 2026-02-06, for an incident of type "Winter Storm". The incident period began on 2026-01-22 and ended on 2026-01-27. The declaration lists 95 designated areas.
